column1: # 20-backup.tsv: the free backup program behind the Backups window (idea 72, HS-3).
# Default off: the App Library does not install it during setup. When a person turns on backups and BorgBackup is
# missing, Backups adds it from this row on request (secure-linux-backup install-borg runs
# secure-linux-app-library install borgbackup). Atomic computers add it once with rpm-ostree instead, so this rpm row
# Columns (TAB separated): id kind title plain_description approx_size_mb profiles default arch idea
# Checked live on packages.fedoraproject.org on 2026-11-16: borgbackup 1.4.5 in Fedora 43, 44 and 45.
# The size (20 MB) is an estimate for the program and its few Python helpers; it was not measured.

column4: The free program behind Backups. It makes encrypted, compressed and checked copies of your home folder. Added when you turn on backups.
